channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: Palm Beach County man arrested after 100+ mph chase through Indiantown forces cars off road
item.description: A Palm Beach County man led Martin County deputies on a high-speed chase through Indiantown after driving more than 100 mph on State Road 710, one of the area's most dangerous roads. Deputies spotted 33-year-old Markell Tillman driving aggressively at speeds exceeding 100 mph, forcing other vehicles

item.title: Martin County residents can get free pool alarms from Safe Kids Treasure Coast
item.description: The Florida Department of Health and Safe Kids Treasure Coast are providing a limited supply of free pool alarms to qualifying Martin County residents.

item.title: Villa Del Sol residents in St. Lucie County return home after nearly two years of structural damage displacement
item.description: Villa Del Sol residents in St. Lucie County are returning home after nearly two years of displacement from their condos. Residents were notified last month they could return to their condos after an inspection in August 2024 found structural damage in buildings 3, 4, and 5, which were deemed unsafe.

item.title: Florida gas prices jump 20 cents a gallon on Tuesday amid Strait of Hormuz tensions
item.description: Florida gas prices rose about 20 cents a gallon Tuesday as military activity in the Strait of Hormuz pushed oil and wholesale gasoline prices higher.

item.title: Palm Beach County commissioners deny private Christian school proposal in Jupiter Farms
item.description: Palm Beach County commissioners voted to deny a controversial proposal to build a large private Christian school in Jupiter Farms after hours of emotional public debate over traffic, growth and the future of the community's rural character.

item.title: Spain advances to World Cup final with 2-0 win over France
item.description: Mikel Oyarzabal scored from the penalty spot and Pedro Porro added another goal as Spain advanced to its first World Cup final since winning in 2010.

item.title: England and Argentina renewed fierce World Cup rivalry in semifinal
item.description: England and Argentina met in the World Cup semifinals in Atlanta on Wednesday, continuing one of the fiercest rivalries in international soccer.

item.title: Police investigate death of South Africa World Cup player Jayden Adams
item.description: Police are investigating the death of South Africa World Cup soccer player Jayden Adams after his body was discovered at a property in Cape Town.

item.title: World Cup semifinals set with four highest-ranked teams
item.description: England and Argentina advanced to join France and Spain in the World Cup semifinals after quarterfinal victories over the weekend.

item.title: Atlanta police increased security for England-Argentina World Cup semifinal
item.description: Police and security presence was boosted for Wednesday's England-Argentina World Cup semifinal in Atlanta due to longstanding tensions between the two nations.

item.title: Port St. Lucie Opens Registration for Free City University Program
item.description:
Registration is now open for Port St. Lucie City University, a free nine-session program designed to help residents better understand how their local government operates.

item.title: Vero Beach parents sue city over infant son's remains allegedly disturbed and reburied without consent
item.description: Adam Chrzan and Tanya Crovo allege their infant son's remains were disturbed during maintenance at Crestlawn Cemetery and reinterred without their knowledge.
